data.notes: It gets the header, the Value proof tag and the real reason right, and it rejects Sam's price framing. It also gives strong actions on the one-page business case for the CFO and on using 'orders dying at the last step'. It never says to compare total cost instead of the rate line (the gateway fee and the chargebacks person), its competitor and message actions are vague or keep things as they are rather than taking value to the decider, and the decider and proof items both say to put the value case in front of finance.
